observations.title: Layered AWS Glue & PySpark Architecture
observations.detail: Data pipelines strictly decouple jobs/ (orchestration), queries/ (SQL extraction), transformations/ (pure computation), resources/ (I/O managers), config/ (runtime setup), and utils/ (constants/enums/DTOs).

observations.title: Catalog Column Access via Enums
observations.detail: Target Glue Data Catalog column names must always be defined and accessed through Enums (e.g., TableColumns.COLUMN.value) to prevent typos and enable clean refactoring.

observations.title: Zero-JVM Mocking Architecture for Glue/Spark
observations.detail: Pytest suites use dynamic MagicMock and proxy classes (MockColumn, MockFunctions, MockTypes) in conftest.py, running full test suites in seconds without requiring a JVM or Spark cluster.

observations.title: Hierarchical Variable Resolution (Azure DevOps -> .env -> Serverless)
observations.detail: Configuration variables must match identically in camelCase across Azure DevOps Variable Groups, .env, and custom.yml. AWS physical names use kebab-case, and CloudFormation IDs use PascalCase.

observations.title: Athena & Iceberg Query Optimization Rules
observations.detail: All Athena queries against Glue Catalog / Apache Iceberg tables must enforce partition filtering on fecha_cargue, avoid SELECT *, and utilize CTEs with constants for parameterized logic.
